entities.name: António Dembo
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: António Nabuco Sebastião Dembo was an Angolan engineer, politician, diplomat and military commander. He served as vice president (1992–2002) and later president (2002) of UNITA, an anti-Communist rebel group that fought against the MPLA in the Angolan Civil War.

entities.summary: António Nabuco Sebastião Dembo was an Angolan engineer, politician, diplomat and military commander. He served as vice president (1992–2002) and later president (2002) of UNITA, an anti-Communist rebel group that fought against the MPLA in the Angolan Civil War.
